title: 開關磁阻馬達控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討磁阻轉矩、相電流成形與換相區間，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore reluctance torque, phase-current shaping and commutation intervals, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。磁路飽和、非線性和機械噪音不可由單一線性式充分描述；僅做模擬與公開資料判讀。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Magnetic saturation, nonlinearity and acoustic behavior exceed one linear equation; work is limited to simulation and public-data interpretation.
